title: Adaptive Trust Chain (ATC): executable specification and reference smart contract
description:
Companion code for Ashraf, S. R. B., Rahman, H., Noche, B., and Gürpinar, T. Adaptive Trust Chain: a permissioned blockchain framework for enforcing weld-parameter compliance at the controller level in green hydrogen infrastructure. Frontiers in Blockchain (under review).

Contents: the WeldComplianceASC Solidity 0.8.20 contract (Algorithm 1) with Hardhat tests; the IEC 61131-3 Structured Text specification of the ASI-PLC compliance-bit logic (Algorithm 2); the Monte Carlo check of the interlock (n = 200, seed 2025); the mixed-population Weibull, Paris–Erdogan and workforce DTMC scenario models; a script that recomputes every reported value; scripts that regenerate Figures 3–5 and Supplementary Figures S1–S2; a Streamlit app and a browser demonstrator.

Research prototype: not deployed, not audited, and not a safety function. All quantitative inputs are scenario assumptions.
